questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A bag has 5 red and 15 blue counters. What is the probability of drawing red, as a fraction out of 20?
questions.why: 5 out of 20 counters are red, so the probability is 5/20, which simplifies to 1/4 or 0.25.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: The probability of picking a striped shirt is 0.55. What is the probability of not picking striped?
questions.why: Complementary probabilities add to 1, so the chance of not picking striped is 1 minus 0.55, which is 0.45.
